definitions.gloss: guilty; having a bad conscience; shady
definitions.explanation: Having something one is ashamed of or wants to hide. Most often in denials: やましいことは{何|なに}もない, "I have nothing to hide."

examples.japanese: やましいことはして⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧やましいこと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧？
examples.english: Do you have something to hide?

examples.japanese: やましい⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：02485_kimochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{見|み}られなかった→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I had a guilty conscience, so I couldn't look him straight in the eye.

notes:
Written {疚|やま}しい; the kanji is rare and the word is usually in kana.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- やましいこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: I have nothing to hide
- やましい⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have something to be ashamed of
- やましさ: guilt (noun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{後|うし}ろめたい→後ろめたい：12547_ushirometai⟧: much the same; slightly more about the feeling, やましい more about the fact that there is something to hide
- ⟦{罪悪感|ざいあくかん}→罪悪感：05951_zaiakukan⟧: a sense of guilt (noun)
